offerings.title: Hours (Hours by appointment)
offerings.body: Since 1956, County Line Veterinary Hospital in Hatboro, Pa., has strived to provide pet owners of Montgomery and Bucks Counties with compassionate, high-quality care and service within a state-of-the-art, full-service veterinary hospital. Proud of the reputation we have earned, Dr. Tracy Heitzman and her staff work hard to ensure you and your pets receive the care, service and welcoming atmosphere they would want for their own.

offerings.title: Open Today!
offerings.body: Please take a look around to learn about the Montgomery County veterinary services offered, meet the doctors and staff and more. If you have any questions or would like to set up an appointment, give us a call at (215) 675-0533.
